text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, rivaroxaban 15 mg tablets are not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 147 tablets (15.2 days), Corvale General holds 218 tablets (22.6 days), and Corvale Lakeside holds 28 tablets (12.6 days) at current daily use rates.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list includes a Janssen Pharmaceuticals rivaroxaban for suspension product marked To Be Discontinued with an initial posting date of 2026-09-18. The tablet presentations we stock are not listed.

Our position: Current tablet inventory provides 12.6 to 22.6 days of supply across sites. The ranked alternate manufacturers are not on FDA's shortage list today. Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited (FEI 3004956904) received a NAI classification on its most recent inspection dated 2024-07-26. No plant locations are identifiable from the alternate manufacturers' labels.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate purchase from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited as first alternate; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
2. Buyer to evaluate purchase from Apotex Corp. as second alternate; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
3. Buyer to evaluate purchase from Aurobindo Pharma Limited as third alternate; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
4. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list weekly for tablet presentations; requires pharmacy director approval for protocol changes.
5. Buyer to coordinate inter-site transfer if any site falls below 7 days on hand; requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
